truly_longitudinal: How much urine do you usually leak (whether you wear protection or not)? - at age 76 years
cat_rows: This category contains data from the questionnaires on digestive and genitourinary conditions, such as issues with stomach, gall bladder, gums and mouth, liver and hernia. It also includes details about constipation and bowel problems. Kidney, bladder infections and incontinence were also added for the genitourinary conditions.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
